briefing: Markets were flat today (NASDAQ +0.0%, S&P 500 +0.1%) with no clear risk-on signal. Cash on hand ($189.29) is below the $500 threshold needed to add a new position, so per past lessons we're holding rather than forcing a trade, and letting the automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules manage the 7 existing positions.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' stance means staying cautious and avoiding new positions when market signals are weak or unclear, rather than forcing a trade just to put cash to work. It's a reminder that patience — holding cash on a neutral day — is itself a valid investment decision.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）指的是在市場信號疲弱或不明朗時保持謹慎，不為了動用現金而勉強交易。這提醒我們：在市場中性的日子裡持有現金、保持耐性，本身也是一種有效的投資決策。

market_education.summary_en: Major indices were essentially unchanged today, with the S&P 500 and NASDAQ both trading in a tight range as investors await fresh catalysts. Without a strong directional signal, institutional volume was subdued and most sectors moved sideways. This kind of quiet consolidation often follows a period of larger moves as the market digests recent gains.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大盤走勢波動不大，標普500與納指均在窄幅區間內整理，市場缺乏明確方向，投資者仍在等待新的催化因素。成交量偏淡，多數板塊呈現橫盤格局。這種平靜的整固階段，通常出現在市場消化前期漲幅之後。
